description: Health-campaign data exported from UNICEF's Integrated Campaign Registry (ICR) FHIR server: the location registry (admin boundaries, health facilities, settlements) as GeoParquet, and every SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition in the ICR Implementation Guide (campaign calendar, target populations, coverage, endemicity) as Parquet. Nigeria and Sierra Leone so far.
title: ICR — Integrated Campaign Registry
